episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Things look bleak for Yoon Hye Jin after she quits her job. On a trip to Gongjin, she runs into a series of unfortunate events and one unusual local.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment I Met You Everywhere

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hye Jin gets ready to welcome patients. But when a mishap at a party lands her in the town's bad graces, she needs guidance from Hong Du Sik.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Heart Smiled at Me

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A long drive to Seoul with Du Sik and other uninvited passengers tests Hye Jin's patience. Despite pain in her teeth, Kim Gam Ri refuses treatment.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Temperature Melted My Heart

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When a patient causes a disturbance at the office, Du Sik comes to the rescue. Elsewhere, Chang Yeong Guk learns that his first love is back in town.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Feelings Floated on the Waves

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hye-Jin is seen leaving Du-sik's home one morning. While she tries to recall what happened the night before, the town's gossip mill goes into overdrive.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Gaze Goes Beyond Friendship

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Hye-jin resolves to stop getting involved with Du-sik. Oh Ju-ri enters a singing competition in an attempt to win money to fix her snaggletooth.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Loneliness Leaned on Me

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Preparing to film his TV show in Gonglin, Ji Seong-hyeon has the perfect house and guide in mind - but getting them takes extra convincing.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Existence Erases the Darkness

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Du-sik catches a nasty cold. Hye-jin notices a troubling trend among her patients. A kidnapper on the loose puts the town on high alert.
episodes.imageAlt: Your Seat, the Moment You Draw Your Daily Life

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Du-sik puts on a a show pretending to be Hye-jin's boyfriend in front of her visiting parents. Seong-hyeon makes a god impression on her father.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Following an intruder attack in her home, a shake Hye-jin leans on Du-sik. She's left more conflicted than ever after Seong-hyeon asks to talk.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment When Your Excitement Becomes My Happiness

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Before Hye-jin makes things official with Du-sik, there's something she needs to do first. Attempts to keep their relationship a secret backfire on them.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Wish Dreams of 'Together'

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Hye Jin compiles a long bucket list of activities she wants to experience with Du Sik. Pyo Mi Seon and Choi Eun Cheol finally arrive on the same page.
episodes.imageAlt: Your Today Is the Moment You Wish for Tomorrow

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: As Du Sik continues to keep his past shrouded in mystery, Hye Jin grows frustrated. Ham Yun Gyeong is struck by an emergency during a typhoon.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Promise Bring Up Courage

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Hye Jin and Du Sik take some time apart. Yu Cho Hui urges Yeong Guk to have courage about his feelings. Seong Hyeon and his team wrap up filming.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Your Sadness Greets Spring

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: With his secrets out in the open, Du-sik must find a way to move on from the tragedies of his past. Hye-jin considers an enticing job offer.
episodes.imageAlt: The Moment Our Lives Dance With Everyone

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: The town gathers to bid goodbye to a loved one. Hye-jim plans an unforgettable event for Du-sik, but it turns out he had the same idea.
